item.text: The endpoint is `/api/admin/upload/file`; it already sends controller errors as HTTP 500. I’ll add a check in that controller against a resolved path under the configured upload directory, require the destination to be a directory, and reuse `[[error:invalid-path]]` for missing or out-of-base paths. The temporary multipart file will still be cleaned up on rejection.

The controller now validates the requested folder before calling the file-save routine, checks that it is an actual directory, and maps missing paths to the shared `[[error:invalid-path]]` token. I’m running the existing admin upload test group next.
